applicant.name: Dr. Test Applicant
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Vienna, Department of Epidemiology

purpose: Research on blood pressure control in hypertension.
question: What is the mean systolic blood pressure of patients with hypertension, by region?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Use the latest systolic blood pressure (LOINC 8480-6) per patient; patients without a value are left out.
Report per region: patients with hypertension who have a systolic blood pressure value and their mean systolic blood pressure, one decimal.
